assetVersion.description: Controls whether response keys and asset identifier fields use Kraken's internal names or display names. Omitted (default): internal names are used, pair keys use the internal format (`XXBTZUSD`), and `base`/`quote`/`fee_volume_currency` use internal names. `assetVersion=1`: display names are used, pair keys become the slash-separated display format (`BTC/USD`), and `base`/`quote`/`fee_volume_currency` also switch to display names. Only `assetVersion=1` is currently supported. The `altname`/`wsname` fields are not affected by this parameter.

pair.description: Asset pairs to get data for (optional, default all tradeable pairs).

aclass_base.description: Filters the asset class to retrieve: `currency` (spot currency pairs) or `tokenized_asset` (tokenized asset pairs, i.e. xstocks).

info.description: Info to retrieve: `info` (all info), `leverage` (leverage info), `fees` (fee schedule), or `margin` (margin info).

country_code.description: Filter for response to only include pairs available in the provided country/region (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code).

execution_venue.description: Filter by execution venue: `international` (International exchange) or `bitnomial_exchange` (Bitnomial exchange).

response.title: AssetPairsFrame
response.description: Wire frame; the generated method returns `result`.

error.description: Wire envelope field; see the core.

result.description: Pair name (or display name, per `assetVersion`) mapped to its info.

aclass_base.description: Asset class of the base component.

base.description: Asset id of the base component.

aclass_quote.description: Asset class of the quote component.

quote.description: Asset id of the quote component.

execution_venue.description: Execution venue where the order book for this pair is listed.

pair_decimals.description: Number of decimal places for prices in this pair.

cost_decimals.description: Number of decimal places for cost of trades in the pair (quote asset terms).

lot_decimals.description: Number of decimal places for volume (base asset terms).

lot_multiplier.description: Amount to multiply lot volume by to get currency volume.

prefixItems.title: volume
prefixItems.description: Volume threshold for this fee tier.

fees_maker.description: Maker fee schedule, if the pair is on maker/taker fees.

prefixItems.title: volume
prefixItems.description: Volume threshold for this fee tier.

margin_level.description: Same value as `margin_stop`, returned under this name instead when `info=margin` is requested. Not in upstream's published field list; confirmed live -- see notes.

ordermin.description: Minimum order size (in terms of base currency).

costmin.description: Minimum order cost (in terms of quote currency).

tick_size.description: Minimum increment between valid price levels.

long_position_limit.description: Maximum long margin position size (in terms of base currency).

short_position_limit.description: Maximum short margin position size (in terms of base currency).

notes: execution_venue's description says 'comma-separated list of execution venues' but the OpenAPI schema itself is a single-value enum (not an array); specced the schema as documented (single enum), not the prose. fees/fees_maker rows are titled 'FeeTier' and reused verbatim for both fields since they're identical [volume, percentFee] shape.

`base`/`quote` (and every other field outside the selected subset) are genuinely NotRequired, confirmed by live capture: `info=leverage`/`fees`/`margin` (examples/info_leverage, info_fees, info_margin) each return only that subset's own fields -- e.g. `info=leverage` returns just `leverage_buy`/`leverage_sell`, omitting `base`/`quote` entirely -- matching the `info` parameter's own description ('selects which subset of fields to return'). Only the default `info=info` mode returns the full `AssetPair` shape, per `examples/default`.

`margin_level` is not in upstream's own published field list, found live while capturing `info=margin` (`examples/info_margin`): for `XXBTZUSD` it returned `{margin_call: 80, margin_level: 40}`, and `examples/default`'s full `info=info` response for the same pair has `margin_call: 80, margin_stop: 40` -- identical value, different key. Specced as a distinct NotRequired field carrying the same fact as `margin_stop`, rather than merged with it, since the two are never observed on the same response and nothing confirms they're guaranteed identical beyond this one sample.
